📖 How to use

  1. Enter the annual contribution, years invested, and expected annual return.
  2. Enter your current tax rate and your expected tax rate in retirement.
  3. Read the after-tax future value of each path.
  4. Compare the difference and the verdict.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the core trade-off?

Traditional: tax deduction now, tax on withdrawals later. Roth: pay tax now, tax-free withdrawals later. This tool compares the after-tax future value of each.

When does Roth usually win?

When your retirement tax rate is higher than today's rate. When it is lower, traditional usually wins. Equal rates make them equivalent.

Does this include contribution limits?

No. It compares equal gross contributions; real-world limits and eligibility rules are not modeled.
